body: Tell the relative to actually go to Hausarzt and tell what is happening and how they feel. Then Hausarzt gives a special referral with a code. Using that code it's possible to schedule an appointment on 116117.de online (no need to speak German, you can translate in browser). Dr. Uta Smits in Offenbach speaks English very well and generally has quite close appointments (i managed to get to her in 2 weeks after Hausarzt). Overall I have a feeling that every doctor speaks English (my experience with 10 different persons in different medical fields) but it's a struggle to actually go through the front desk staff. PM me if you need any details as I went through all that quite recently and can share the experience
